about.title: About
about.description: The story of Mây Coffee Roasters, a small-batch specialty roastery in Đà Lạt.
about.heading: A small roastery, roasted by hand
about.intro: Mây Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee workshop in Đà Lạt. We roast in small batches — a few kilos at a time — so each one can be tasted and adjusted before it is bagged.
about.body1Heading: From the highlands to the drum
about.body1: Our beans come from Vietnam's coffee-growing highlands — from Cầu Đất, right above the workshop, to Sơn La in the far north. Each lot is cupped before we buy it and cupped again after it is roasted, so what you taste in the cup is what we tasted in the cupping room.
about.body2: Drop by the workshop at 24 Hùng Vương to try a cup before you choose a bag. We pour by phin or V60, whichever shows the coffee best — and we're happy to talk through roast levels and grind size for home brewing.
